rec.feature.name: Bankruptcy recovery

rec.param.preWarning.tooltip: A letter when the balance gets close to the default threshold.
rec.param.startupCredit.tooltip: A credit line for the first three years of the company, with an auto draw near the default threshold. What was already drawn keeps being served when this is off.
rec.param.bridgeLoan.tooltip: A one-year loan that covers a deficit. Turning it off stops new loans; the ones taken keep being repaid.
rec.param.bailout.tooltip: A rescue offer on the last day of a default: a rescue loan or an investor share. Turning it off brings back the game's own bankruptcy.
rec.param.earlyExit.tooltip: The default is cancelled when the balance stays above the threshold for several days in a row, without waiting for day 120.
